title: Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #08 (부채꼴·물결 | 목재+금박+코이비늘+공작눈무늬)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, long sleek jet-black hair cascading past hips — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 59% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 12 o'clock, 2 o'clock, 5 o'clock and 9 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 2 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries pale golden oak wood fused directly into her own form, natural straight grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING warm honey-blonde grain with VIVID amber highlight streaks. Region 2 is the wedge between the 2 o'clock ray and the 5 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied ELECTRIC EMERALD leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 3 is the wedge between the 5 o'clock ray and the 9 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the wedge between the 9 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL eye-marking centres, VIVID GOLD radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
